features.name: spiral ascent layout
features.notes: Platforms wrap or stack directly above one another
features.quote: Tower / Spiral Ascent: A course wrapping or stacking so platforms sit directly above each other

features.name: sequential platform track
features.notes: Ordered chain of widely spaced platforms rising through the tower
features.quote: A chain of platforms spaced to the physics limits above — the ordered route through the course

features.name: timed obstacle platforms
features.notes: Visually distinct vanishing or activation-based platforms
features.quote: Platforms that vanish after being stepped on, or a set time after activation

features.name: climbing obstacle sections
features.notes: Include visible trusses, ladders, tightropes, or wall-scramble surfaces
features.quote: Trusses, ladders, tightropes, and wall scrambles

features.name: end reward area
features.notes: Distinct area at the top or end of the course containing payoff items
features.quote: A distinct reward area at the end of the course holding the payoff items

excluded.name: horror transformation
excluded.why: state change over gameplay rather than static visible layout
